content:
Oasis toolbar pill

Launcher next to the main toolbar controls opens the assistant; uses the Oasis launcher icon and can be auto-placed after the VPN / IP Protection control when that widget exists.

What this is

The Oasis control on the main toolbar opens the assistant. It uses the Oasis launcher icon. The browser may place it next to the VPN (IP Protection) control when that widget is available.

How to use it

  • Look for the Oasis icon on the right side of the main toolbar (near extensions and menu).
  • Click the pill to show or focus the Oasis Assistant (sidebar or overlay, depending on layout).
  • If you use VPN controls, the pill may sit beside that button for a consistent “protection + AI” cluster.

Notes and limits

If the icon appears blank after an update, ensure you are on the latest build; the launcher is packaged as part of the browser skin.
